site.name: Quickler
site.description: Quickler is a WhatsApp report writer for anyone who inspects or keeps records: care homes, nurseries, schools, estates teams, cleaning firms and trades. The person on the job answers in WhatsApp by voice note, text or photo, and Quickler writes the Record and the report in the firm's own layout. No new app to install. £75 a month for each phone number, after a 14-day free trial.

preferred_flow: read what Quickler does on homepage
read FAQ or workflow page matching the user's use case
submit contact form or start free trial at app.quickler.co/signup

primary_positioning: AI-first report writer for assessors. The person on site answers in WhatsApp by voice note, text or photo; AI writes the finished report in the firm's own template. No new app to install. £75 a month for each phone number on the account, after a 14-day free trial. EU data residency.

workflows.name: EICR
workflows.description: Electrical Installation Condition Report captured on WhatsApp with photo evidence. C1, C2 and FI codes flagged live on dashboard. Formatted EICR PDF for qualifying electrician sign-off.

workflows.name: CP12
workflows.description: Landlord Gas Safety Record: appliance checks recorded on WhatsApp by Gas Safe registered gas workers. A formatted CP12 PDF is produced from what they say.

workflows.name: Van safety checks
workflows.description: DVSA daily walkround on WhatsApp. Defect photos to fleet manager. Red, amber, green status per vehicle live.

workflows.name: Site inspection reports
workflows.description: Structural site notes, photos, sketches and measurements captured on WhatsApp during the visit. Structured draft report ready immediately.

queries: no new app for your team to install

pricing.annual_note: two months free when paid a year up front
